c1_dinner.birthday.01.speaker: mateo
c1_dinner.birthday.01.text: I drove her here. Rafa drove her home. Midnight, give or take ten minutes.
c1_dinner.birthday.01.spoken_text: I drove her here. Rafa drove her home. Midnight, give or take ten minutes.

c1_dinner.family.02.speaker: luis
c1_dinner.family.02.text: Eat before it gets cold, Steve. Then tell us what is troubling you.
c1_dinner.family.02.spoken_text: Eat before it gets cold, Steve. Then tell us what is troubling you.

c1_dinner.in.01.speaker: carmen
c1_dinner.in.01.text: Your plate is warm. Sit. You can apologize while you eat.
c1_dinner.in.01.spoken_text: Your plate is warm. Sit. You can apologize while you eat.

c1_dinner.in.02.speaker: rafa
c1_dinner.in.02.text: I kept the sauce separate. You used to like it that way.
c1_dinner.in.02.spoken_text: I kept the sauce separate. You used to like it that way.

c1_dinner.out.01.speaker: carmen
c1_dinner.out.01.text: She stopped arguing with me. My daughter has argued with me since she could talk.
c1_dinner.out.01.spoken_text: She stopped arguing with me. My daughter has argued with me since she could talk.

c1_dinner.podcast.01.speaker: tomas
c1_dinner.podcast.01.text: You can borrow them. You could also have listened any time in the last three years.
c1_dinner.podcast.01.spoken_text: You can borrow them. You could also have listened any time in the last three years.

c1_escape.cross.01.speaker: steve
c1_escape.cross.01.text: Sorry. Sorry. Those were your irises.
c1_escape.cross.01.spoken_text: Sorry. Sorry. Those were your irises.

c1_escape.in.01.speaker: iris
c1_escape.in.01.text: No. He does not know where the notebook is. Tonight? Understood.
c1_escape.in.01.spoken_text: No. He does not know where the notebook is. Tonight? Understood.

c1_escape.in.02.speaker: steve
c1_escape.in.02.text: Nora? Why is the front door locked from the outside?
c1_escape.in.02.spoken_text: Nora? Why is the front door locked from the outside?

c1_escape.order.01.speaker: steve
c1_escape.order.01.text: Noon to midnight at La Marea. Mateo and Rafa both saw her. She couldn’t have signed this there.
c1_escape.order.01.spoken_text: Noon to midnight at La Marea. Mateo and Rafa both saw her. She couldn’t have signed this there.

c1_escape.out.01.speaker: steve
c1_escape.out.01.text: She could have stopped me. She stood there and let me go.
c1_escape.out.01.spoken_text: She could have stopped me. She stood there and let me go.

c1_escape.power.01.speaker: steve
c1_escape.power.01.text: I fixed this latch for Mr. Bell last winter. He paid me in fruitcake. Tonight it’s worth every slice.
c1_escape.power.01.spoken_text: I fixed this latch for Mr. Bell last winter. He paid me in fruitcake. Tonight it’s worth every slice.

c1_flat.compare.01.speaker: steve
c1_flat.compare.01.text: She remembers our first date better than I do. But nobody says a sentence the same way twice. Nobody.
c1_flat.compare.01.spoken_text: She remembers our first date better than I do. But nobody says a sentence the same way twice. Nobody.

c1_flat.control.01.speaker: steve
c1_flat.control.01.text: Testing. One, two. Testing... one, two.
c1_flat.control.01.spoken_text: Testing. One, two. Testing... one, two.

c1_flat.control.02.speaker: steve
c1_flat.control.02.text: The squeak only made the second pass. So the recorder’s fine. Cross that one out.
c1_flat.control.02.spoken_text: The squeak only made the second pass. So the recorder’s fine. Cross that one out.

c1_flat.in.02.speaker: steve
c1_flat.in.02.text: Three in the morning. Again. Well, Mom, it’s a fine night for it.
c1_flat.in.02.spoken_text: Three in the morning. Again. Well, Mom, it’s a fine night for it.

c1_flat.in.03.speaker: autorick
c1_flat.in.03.text: Good morning, Bellwether! Yesterday will be sunny.
c1_flat.in.03.spoken_text: Good morning, Bellwether! Yesterday will be sunny.

c1_flat.out.01.speaker: steve
c1_flat.out.01.text: Same breath. Same tiny click before the second word.
c1_flat.out.01.spoken_text: Same breath. Same tiny click before the second word.

c1_flat.out.02.speaker: steve
c1_flat.out.02.text: I need evidence. Being afraid of something doesn’t make it true.
c1_flat.out.02.spoken_text: I need evidence. Being afraid of something doesn’t make it true.

c1_flat.saturday.01.speaker: steve
c1_flat.saturday.01.text: Saturday, kitchen, quarter past seven. Dad always said to put the date on everything.
c1_flat.saturday.01.spoken_text: Saturday, kitchen, quarter past seven. Dad always said to put the date on everything.

c1_flat.sunday.02.speaker: steve
c1_flat.sunday.02.text: Sunday. Fresh tape. Same words. Same... everything.
c1_flat.sunday.02.spoken_text: Sunday. Fresh tape. Same words. Same... everything.

c1_pier.bait.01.speaker: agnes
c1_pier.bait.01.text: Count the nights, Steven. You were always good with numbers when you wrote them down.
c1_pier.bait.01.spoken_text: Count the nights, Steven. You were always good with numbers when you wrote them down.

c1_pier.door.01.speaker: lyle_copy
c1_pier.door.01.text: They’re both pitching today. I promised I’d watch every inning.
c1_pier.door.01.spoken_text: They’re both pitching today. I promised I’d watch every inning.

c1_pier.door.02.speaker: steve
c1_pier.door.02.text: Deputy Lyle, keeping a promise. I should write that down before the world ends.
c1_pier.door.02.spoken_text: Deputy Lyle, keeping a promise. I should write that down before the world ends.

c1_pier.in.01.speaker: steve
c1_pier.in.01.text: Admiral. That was my lunch. You don’t even like rye.
c1_pier.in.01.spoken_text: Admiral. That was my lunch. You don’t even like rye.

c1_pier.in.02.speaker: agnes
c1_pier.in.02.text: Fish don’t sing, Steven. Something under them does.
c1_pier.in.02.spoken_text: Fish don’t sing, Steven. Something under them does.

c1_pier.out.01.speaker: pell
c1_pier.out.01.text: Your parents’ mail, Mr. Mercer. Delivered precisely on schedule.
c1_pier.out.01.spoken_text: Your parents’ mail, Mr. Mercer. Delivered precisely on schedule.

c1_pier.out.02.speaker: steve
c1_pier.out.02.text: They haven’t been home in eighteen months, Dale. You know that.
c1_pier.out.02.spoken_text: They haven’t been home in eighteen months, Dale. You know that.

c1_pier.whistle.01.speaker: steve
c1_pier.whistle.01.text: You always come for that whistle. What’s different today?
c1_pier.whistle.01.spoken_text: You always come for that whistle. What’s different today?

c2_aquarium.guard.01.speaker: steve
c2_aquarium.guard.01.text: The cough was in exactly the same place. That corridor has a recording.
c2_aquarium.guard.01.spoken_text: The cough was in exactly the same place. That corridor has a recording.

c2_aquarium.in.01.speaker: steve
c2_aquarium.in.01.text: Emergency. Bellwether Aquarium. Someone is... hello?
c2_aquarium.in.01.spoken_text: Emergency. Bellwether Aquarium. Someone is... hello?

c2_aquarium.in.02.speaker: steve
c2_aquarium.in.02.text: Half a sentence before the line died. I hope someone heard it.
c2_aquarium.in.02.spoken_text: Half a sentence before the line died. I hope someone heard it.

c2_aquarium.intercom.01.speaker: nora
c2_aquarium.intercom.01.text: Two short notes. If Admiral can hear me, perhaps somebody else can.
c2_aquarium.intercom.01.spoken_text: Two short notes. If Admiral can hear me, perhaps somebody else can.

c2_aquarium.out.01.speaker: nora
c2_aquarium.out.01.text: My name is Nora Reyes, and somebody just walked out of here wearing my face.
c2_aquarium.out.01.spoken_text: My name is Nora Reyes, and somebody just walked out of here wearing my face.

c2_aquarium.out.02.speaker: steve
c2_aquarium.out.02.text: Five months. I didn’t notice for five months.
c2_aquarium.out.02.spoken_text: Five months. I didn’t notice for five months.

c2_aquarium.plan.01.text: Nora showed me this when I repaired the underwater speakers.
c2_aquarium.plan.01.spoken_text: Nora showed me this when I repaired the underwater speakers.

c2_ship.escape.02.speaker: steve
c2_ship.escape.02.text: It worked. Now the seawater valve. Then I find out how long I can hold my breath.
c2_ship.escape.02.spoken_text: It worked. Now the seawater valve. Then I find out how long I can hold my breath.

c2_ship.in.01.speaker: iris
c2_ship.in.01.text: Please come with us. They want to know where your mother put her notebook.
c2_ship.in.01.spoken_text: Please come with us. They want to know where your mother put her notebook.

c2_ship.in.02.speaker: guard
c2_ship.in.02.text: Would peaceful human hold music assist your experience?
c2_ship.in.02.spoken_text: Would peaceful human hold music assist your experience?

c2_ship.in.03.speaker: steve
c2_ship.in.03.text: I’d prefer the exit. Does that come with music too?
c2_ship.in.03.spoken_text: I’d prefer the exit. Does that come with music too?

c2_ship.nora.01.speaker: steve
c2_ship.nora.01.text: I kept waiting until I knew what to say. I’m here now. I should have been here sooner.
c2_ship.nora.01.spoken_text: I kept waiting until I knew what to say. I’m here now. I should have been here sooner.

c2_ship.out.01.speaker: steve
c2_ship.out.01.text: The room is flooding. The underwater speakers still work... Nora’s whistle.
c2_ship.out.01.spoken_text: The room is flooding. The underwater speakers still work... Nora’s whistle.

c3_archive.cycle.01.speaker: steve
c3_archive.cycle.01.text: Same interval across three years. We watch the beach on the next ninth night.
c3_archive.cycle.01.spoken_text: Same interval across three years. We watch the beach on the next ninth night.

c3_archive.in.01.text: Three years of recordings. Original timestamps. You can stop calling it a hobby now.
c3_archive.in.01.spoken_text: Three years of recordings. Original timestamps. You can stop calling it a hobby now.

c3_archive.out.01.speaker: calder
c3_archive.out.01.text: Two hundred and seventy-four. My list had thirty-one.
c3_archive.out.01.spoken_text: Two hundred and seventy-four. My list had thirty-one.

c3_archive.out.03.speaker: steve
c3_archive.out.03.text: A message: he remembers june. that doesnt mean hes adrian.
c3_archive.out.03.spoken_text: A message: He remembers June. That does not mean he is Adrian.

c3_archive.paper.01.text: Two places. Same time. Witnesses on both documents.
c3_archive.paper.01.spoken_text: Two places. Same time. Witnesses on both documents.

c3_archive.power.01.speaker: steve
c3_archive.power.01.text: A world-changing machine with a very modest dryer cycle.
c3_archive.power.01.spoken_text: A world-changing machine with a very modest dryer cycle.

c3_house.crossword.02.speaker: calder
c3_house.crossword.02.text: No copy is that bad at this. And you’ve put coffee in my lap.
c3_house.crossword.02.spoken_text: No copy is that bad at this. And you’ve put coffee in my lap.

c3_house.in.01.speaker: calder
c3_house.in.01.text: Forty-seven casseroles. Your town is either very worried or very hungry.
c3_house.in.01.spoken_text: Forty-seven casseroles. Your town is either very worried or very hungry.

c3_house.in.02.speaker: steve
c3_house.in.02.text: Nora is asleep on a ship under the bay. I know exactly how that sounds.
c3_house.in.02.spoken_text: Nora is asleep on a ship under the bay. I know exactly how that sounds.

c3_house.in.03.speaker: calder
c3_house.in.03.text: Then we start with what you can prove.
c3_house.in.03.spoken_text: Then we start with what you can prove.

c3_house.mail.01.text: A most diligent animal. I will return at the scheduled interval.
c3_house.mail.01.spoken_text: A most diligent animal. I will return at the scheduled interval.

c3_house.mail.02.text: He’s asleep. That is his schedule.
c3_house.mail.02.spoken_text: He’s asleep. That is his schedule.

c3_house.out.01.speaker: calder
c3_house.out.01.text: For a year I’ve kept a list. People who got better overnight. Thirty-one names.
c3_house.out.01.spoken_text: For a year I’ve kept a list. People who got better overnight. Thirty-one names.

c3_house.out.02.speaker: steve
c3_house.out.02.text: Then let’s find out which of them got better, and which of them got replaced.
c3_house.out.02.spoken_text: Then let’s find out which of them got better, and which of them got replaced.

c3_house.rules.01.speaker: calder
c3_house.rules.01.text: We do this fairly. Otherwise we’re just frightened people making a list.
c3_house.rules.01.spoken_text: We do this fairly. Otherwise we’re just frightened people making a list.

c4_escape.fault.01.text: Test circuit. No heat, no flame. Just enough bureaucracy to get us outside.
c4_escape.fault.01.spoken_text: Test circuit. No heat, no flame. Just enough bureaucracy to get us outside.

c4_escape.in.01.text: I don’t need you to be brave, Steve. I need you to be honest.
c4_escape.in.01.spoken_text: I don’t need you to be brave, Steve. I need you to be honest.

c4_escape.in.02.speaker: steve
c4_escape.in.02.text: Rook is one of them. I have proof.
c4_escape.in.02.spoken_text: Rook is one of them. I have proof.

c4_escape.out.01.spoken_text: Scan Calder tonight. The signing is in six days.

c4_escape.out.02.speaker: steve
c4_escape.out.02.text: And now I’m wanted for kidnapping Nora. I have to keep moving.
c4_escape.out.02.spoken_text: And now I’m wanted for kidnapping Nora. I have to keep moving.

c4_escape.tube.01.text: I’ll keep his attention. You get out. We both know you can’t bluff him in person.
c4_escape.tube.01.spoken_text: I’ll keep his attention. You get out. We both know you can’t bluff him in person.

c4_escape.van.01.text: I meant to land on my feet. The ditch had other plans.
c4_escape.van.01.spoken_text: I meant to land on my feet. The ditch had other plans.

c4_safe.in.01.speaker: rook_copy
c4_safe.in.01.text: We’ll take the tapes as evidence. You may keep the recorder.
c4_safe.in.01.spoken_text: We’ll take the tapes as evidence. You may keep the recorder.

c4_safe.in.02.speaker: calder
c4_safe.in.02.text: Adrian and I go back a long way.
c4_safe.in.02.spoken_text: Adrian and I go back a long way.

c4_safe.match.01.speaker: steve
c4_safe.match.01.text: Same breath, pause and room click. This is the man the message warned us about.
c4_safe.match.01.spoken_text: Same breath, pause and room click. This is the man the message warned us about.

c4_safe.out.01.speaker: steve
c4_safe.out.01.text: The same breath. He knows June because someone copied a man who knew June.
c4_safe.out.01.spoken_text: The same breath. He knows June because someone copied a man who knew June.

c4_safe.record.02.text: That’s the line. Keep the whole take.
c4_safe.record.02.spoken_text: That’s the line. Keep the whole take.

c4_safe.screens.01.speaker: steve
c4_safe.screens.01.text: Adrian Rook. Asleep. Both governments... and President Ward is next.
c4_safe.screens.01.spoken_text: Adrian Rook. Asleep. Both governments... and President Ward is next.

i1_archive.in.01.speaker: gus
i1_archive.in.01.text: I invented a kelp croissant. Nobody asked for it. I wanted to know what it would taste like.
i1_archive.in.01.spoken_text: I invented a kelp croissant. Nobody asked for it. I wanted to know what it would taste like.

i1_archive.in.02.text: Your record contains no such recipe.
i1_archive.in.02.spoken_text: Your record contains no such recipe.

i1_archive.out.01.speaker: archivist
i1_archive.out.01.text: Memory damaged by scan. Details in subject’s notebook.
i1_archive.out.01.spoken_text: Memory damaged by scan. Details in subject’s notebook.

i1_archive.out.02.speaker: archivist
i1_archive.out.02.text: I will leave the report as it is.
i1_archive.out.02.spoken_text: I will leave the report as it is.

i1_archive.quiet.01.text: The fleet’s message is one word. Deliver.
i1_archive.quiet.01.spoken_text: The fleet’s message is one word. Deliver.

i1_archive.quiet.02.speaker: archivist
i1_archive.quiet.02.text: And who will come to check?
i1_archive.quiet.02.spoken_text: And who will come to check?

i1_archive.quiet.03.speaker: archivist
i1_archive.quiet.03.text: Three hundred years, and you still will not tell me where your people went.
i1_archive.quiet.03.spoken_text: Three hundred years, and you still will not tell me where your people went.

i1_archive.reset.02.speaker: gus
i1_archive.reset.02.text: Good evening. May I help you?
i1_archive.reset.02.spoken_text: Good evening. May I help you?

i1_archive.signals.01.speaker: archivist
i1_archive.signals.01.text: The same performance. Again. I knew this a year ago.
i1_archive.signals.01.spoken_text: The same performance. Again. I knew this a year ago.

p_bay.in.01.speaker: frank
p_bay.in.01.text: Same interval as last Thursday, Helen. Louder out here. Whatever it is, it keeps better time than I do.
p_bay.in.01.spoken_text: Same interval as last Thursday, Helen. Louder out here. Whatever it is, it keeps better time than I do.

p_bay.in.02.speaker: helen
p_bay.in.02.text: Steve would hear more in this than both of us put together. I’ll leave him a message.
p_bay.in.02.spoken_text: Steve would hear more in this than both of us put together. I’ll leave him a message.

p_bay.message.01.spoken_text: He should hear this for himself. We’ll bring the tape home, and he’ll tell us we recorded it wrong.

p_bay.tune.01.spoken_text: There you are. Hear that, Helen? More than one voice, all holding the same note.

p_veyr.in.01.text: There are forty thousand names on the departure register. I have checked every one.
p_veyr.in.01.spoken_text: There are forty thousand names on the departure register. I have checked every one.

p_veyr.levels.01.text: Leave room for the loud parts. They belong to the record too.
p_veyr.levels.01.spoken_text: Leave room for the loud parts. They belong to the record too.

p_veyr.out.02.speaker: archivist
p_veyr.out.02.text: I will remember where we lived.
p_veyr.out.02.spoken_text: I will remember where we lived.
